savedNote: The file holds the records and fields of this view, with its saved filter, sort and hidden fields.
unsavedNote: This view has unsaved changes: the file follows the saved view. Save the changes first to export them.
started: Exporting {{name}} as {{format}}. The download starts in a moment.

localeNote: Numbers and dates are written as your account shows them ({{locale}}, {{timeZone}}).
